newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SINGAPORE BUNKERS SUPPORTED BY FIRMER SWAPS.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE BUNKERS SUPPORTED BY FIRMER SWAPS.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were firm as sellers offered at higher levels amid rising swap prices, traders said on Thursday.
They said 380-cst sellers were at $106/$108 per tonne and 180-cst was offered at around $109-$111.

"The offers are coming in from a high level but it is expected to settle at about a dollar firmer than yesterday," one supplier said. Late Wednesday 380-cst was sold at up to $106.00 per tonne, one bunker seller said.
MDO and gas oil were indicated at $168 and $178 per tonne, respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3093)
